howToPlay: Use the basic attack to sustain yourself with shields and provide protection to allies. Deploy the shield generator strategically to absorb incoming damage while slowing enemies or increasing its durability with star powers. Utilize gadgets for extra mobility or to apply debuffs to opponents.
gears: Equip SHIELD and HEALTH to maximize survivability given the 2000 health stat. GADGET COOLDOWN is also useful to utilize wind-powered or green grenade more frequently.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who prefer a defensive support role focused on shielding teammates and controlling the battlefield area.
